pulls.author: benshuai5D
pulls.body_excerpt: Please review this enhancement. **Problem:** Gtests using `os::random()` share the VM's random state. pulls.author: merykitty
pulls.body_excerpt: Hi, In principle, when iteration split fixes the inputs of a `Phi` at the post-loop head, it needs to look at the corresponding `Phi` at the head of the outer main-loop, not the inner main-loop. However, since the `Phi`s for the outer main-loop are only constructed during macro expansion, iteration split tries to infer from the `Phi` of the inner main-loop instead. In most of the cases, the loop back input of the inner `Phi` is the same as that of the outer `Phi`, so the algorithm is mostly correct. pulls.title: 8379790: MemNode::can_see_stored_value incorrectly walks past barriers
pulls.author: merykitty
pulls.body_excerpt: Hi, `MemNode::can_see_stored_value` tries to look through memory barriers, it does so as if it tries to move a load up past the barriers. This is only true when called by a `LoadNode`. Fortunately, `StoreNode` only calls `can_see_stored_value` on a result of `find_previous_store`, and `find_previous_store` gives up on `MemBarNode`s. As a result, there is no misopimization due to this issue. This PR refactors the "look through barriers" part into a method of `LoadNode` and makes `MemNode::can_see_stored_value` only see if `st` is a store. pulls.author: merykitty

pulls.author: merykitty
pulls.body_excerpt: Hi, This patch adds unsigned bounds and known bits constraints to `TypeInt` and `TypeLong`.
